notes.title: Vigrid Content Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31268797/12b1939ddd640aa4382d508af44c5b30936f1f06.png[/img]


[b]Vigrid Update Release:[/b]

With our first major content update of the year, this update will bring new dungeons that grant players with new equipment items such as Charm, Belt, and Fifth Badge. This update will also reintroduce our most popular event: Ascension Burning (Lv. 5000+) that can help players reach up to Lv. 5000 with ease! Discover the story of the parallel universe of the Luminous City and find out the mysteries of the great return of Hel.

For more information about the content update, please click [url=https://latale.papayaplay.com/latale.do?tp=update_vigrid]HERE[/url].


[b]Memorial System Revamp:[/b]

La Tale has listened to player feedback and implemented significant improvements in our memorial content. Players will have the opportunity to keep their current stats and options when rerolling their memorial slots. Also, all memorial fragments have been combined into a single fragment: Hero’s Fragment. Ascension Memorial slots were also added to give players options to level up their specific skills.

For our patch notes, please click [url=https://latale.papayaplay.com/latale.do?tp=news.view&postid=4985]HERE[/url].



[b]Cross-Promotion with Tree of Savior:[/b]

La Tale is excited to collaborate with one of Papaya Play's latest game product: Tree of Savior. As part of this cross-promotion, La Tale players can participate in a special login bingo event with a guaranteed prizes worth up to $40 USD. This collaboration showcases the shared commitment of Papaya Play's titles to deliver engaging and rewarding experiences to their communities.

For more information about the LT x TOS Bingo Event, please click [url=https://www.papayaplay.com/latale.do?tp=event_binggo]HERE[/url].



For more information on these exciting updates and to engage with the La Tale community, visit the official Discord channel at (https://discord.gg/AV2xhrN7). Explore the captivating world of La Tale and stay up to date by visiting the official website at (https://latale.papayaplay.com/latale.do).

notes.title: Gatekeeper Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31268797/5014aaca4184892c6fff4e23d6b3829c45fa40b2.jpg[/img]

This new update brings a new main class: the Gatekeeper, which uses dual chakrams for its unique combat style. The chakrams can create a magical gateway, which teleports players and monsters between two points in space.

Also included in this new update is La Tale’s latest Ultra Burning event, which can assist players level up to Lv. 3500. With the Ultra Burning package contains in their Gift Bundle, players can burn their way to high levels through quests provided by the NPC Toma. Players will be rewarded with gear suitable to their level as they progress.

Among other new content are new fashion sets and hairstyles. Equipment upgrade buffs on Nightmare Weapons, Belts, Necklaces, Badges, and Relics will help players catch up to the new equipment featured on Aie Island.

For our full patch notes, please visit: [url=https://latale.papayaplay.com/latale.do?tp=update_gatekeeper]Gatekeeper Update[/url]

notes.title: Aie Island Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31268797/c660f6654d10079e0915c3ee680f1f84913d2c7a.jpg[/img]

Aie Island update is now applied to our live server! This new update will bring two new dungeons: Chaotic Mirror (Lv. 3700), and Theater Eugamon (Lv. 4000). These dungeons provide players with new equipment options, such as the Scylla Belt, Doll Necklace, Doll Badges, and Doll Weapons.

Along with this new update, Aie Island itself is revealed with the stories of Scylla and Glaucos. Explore the new area and attend the theater that’s been prepared for all the island’s visitors. New weapons can be upgraded into two versions: Manic and Sacrificial. Manic weapons focus on Critical Rate and Damage, while Sacrificial weapons focus on Cooldown Reductions. Players select their choice of weapon upgrade, based on their classes.

For our full patch notes, please visit: [url=https://latale.papayaplay.com/latale.do?tp=update_aie]Aie Island Update[/url]

notes.title: Space of Life: Pneuma Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31268797/5db43a8f54dcd4bd88ef3c907e38bf3e5488f753.jpg[/img]

Gaia has abandoned her beloved world: Pneuma. Will you be able to protect this land filled with spirits? Explore the world of Pneuma and challenge yourself in dungeons: Kairos' Time / Chronos' Time!

This new update, Pneuma is revealed with the stories of two spirits: Kairos and Chronos. Explore the new area and conquer the new dungeons: Kairos’ Time (Lv. 3200), Chronos’ Time (Lv. 3400), and Unknown Forest (Lv. 3500). These new dungeons will provide players with a new Sticker, Charm, Gems, and Badge 6.

Other quality of life changes has been added such as pet extension pages, a permanent version of Compass equipment, new hairstyles, eye types, fashion items, and damage skins. Event systems also have been reworked to fit our new and refreshing events: Event Missions and Event Exchanges.

[b]All events in La Tale will now follow your local time!

Attendance / Playtime events will be available at Sept. 8th 04:30 of your local time, while other events will be available at Sept. 8th 00:00 of your local time.[/b]

For our full patch notes, please visit: [url=https://latale.papayaplay.com/latale.do?tp=update_pneuma]Pneuma Update[/url]

notes.title: Embark on The Summoner's Quest!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31268797/ca6fb90b8c4c0eff8f582d0e136fd8503faaea8f.png[/img]

Following the events at Lumen City, mysterious Summonable Monsters have started appearing across the world of La Tale, seeking worthy Heroes to whom they can lend their strength. Embark on a globetrotting journey in Part 2 of the City of Light Update to discover these creatures and master each of their unique abilities. Incredible new Skills await those who can train their summons to reach their true potential…

[h1]Summonables[/h1]
Four powerful Summonable Monsters can now be obtained, including:
[list]
[*]Kardian, Guardian Dragon of Elias Royalty
[*]Erazer, Transforming Electronic Golem
[*]Lustral, Powerful Sentient Treasure
[*]Beatrice, Vampire Princess
[/list]

[h1]Taming[/h1]
Summonable Monsters can be collected by completing levelled quests located throughout the world, though only one can be tamed at a time. One of the Monsters is hidden at the start, and can only be obtained once certain conditions are met…

[h1]Training[/h1]
[list]
[*]EXP and reward items can be obtained through Summonable training.
[*]Summonables can be evolved by accumulating EXP obtained through training.
[*]A new skill will be added as each Summonable Monster evolves.
[/list]

[h1]Skills[/h1]
[list]
[*]Summonables possess Passive Skills and Attack Skills.
[*]Each Summonable's Active Skills can be turned ON or OFF. To use your Summonable's skill you need to first turn it ON.
[*]Skills can be activated only when a Summonable is summoned.
[*]A Summonable's skill level can only be raised through items that are obtained through training.
[/list]

[h1]Unknown Warehouse Expansion[/h1]
Five new levels are now available in the Unknown Warehouse, allowing exploration through levels 51—55. These new levels are exceptionally difficult and offer a new range of special bonuses for those strong enough to conquer them.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31268797/3cb7df55eae3fca94ad658f940e052123e664297.png[/img]

[h1]Beatrice's Beautiful Fashion[/h1]
The vampire princess Beatrice really knows how to dress to impress, and she wants to share some of her best outfits with you. Keep an eye out for 7 all-new stylish outfits in the Fashion Shop!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31268797/3f61cd729aef9c8b52ec97f7b1204077007d2dbb.png[/img]

[h1]Erazer's Events[/h1]
After careful calculation, Erazer’s come up with the optimal events to go along with The Summoner's Quest. Check out this month’s events to earn some awesome prizes and supercharge your new pet training!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31268797/18190d4a95bf692f663dc5ba01f325bd0f2f46cc.png[/img]

[h1]Summoners Sales[/h1]
Want to be one of the first to unlock your pet’s full potential? Check out the latest sales in the Fashion Shop for boosts and the all-new Eden’s Courage Premium Box to push your training to the next level!

[b]Check out the full Summoner's Quest details here:[/b]
[url=https://latale.papayaplay.com/latale.do?tp=update180613]The Summoner's Quest Website[/url]

notes.title: Treasure Beach Update Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31268797/77c4c15be5ee56a291d5364493d80e130cb01d0b.jpg[/img]

The Treasure Beach is officially open and explorers the world over are flocking to its perilous shores in a gambit to strike it rich. Embark on an expedition to uncover the treasures of the past, and defend an ancient city from a mad scientist intent on exploiting its secrets. Augment this tropical adventure with revamped runes and Imprint Slots, then reach new heights with the all-new Ascendant Level System. Set sail, Hero, your fortune awaits!

[h1]The Treasure Beach Update features:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]8 Scenario Quests
    [*]2 New Standard Quests
    [*]3 New Zones
    [*]22 New Monsters
    [*]2 New Bosses
    [*]And much more!
[/list]

[h1]Imprint System[/h1]
The Rune System has been streamlined into the new Imprint System, allowing glyphs to be assigned to their own individual slots. Try out different sets of Imprints to forge the ultimate glyph combination.

[h1]Ascendant Levels[/h1]
Reach heights never before possible with the new Ascendant Levels. Surpassing level 235 now unlocks new Ascendant Experience, which grants Ascendant Points in place of usual level-ups that can be spent for additional stats.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31268797/1bd1808278cae9c85c507b314b518f81feeddb38.jpg[/img]

[h1]Fashion Shop Sales[/h1]
Uncover the new Ignate’s Cache Premium Box and several new Outfit Items available now in the Fashion Shop. The Premium Bonus prizes, awarded for every 7000 LTC spent, have also been updated, so you can get even more loot with your Treasure Beach bounty!

[h1]Treasure Beach Events[/h1]
Exciting events will be taking place throughout the update period, highlighting the new content and granting valuable prizes. Gain extra rewards just for playing the game and get the most out of the new update!

[b]Check out the full update details on the Treasure Beach Website:[/b]
https://latale.papayaplay.com/latale.do?tp=update180220
